THE CLAUSE

Users can always access a transparent experience via our direct-to-consumer products.

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 users can always access a transparent experience through OpenAI's direct-to-consumer products

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  1. «U is a user of an OpenAI direct-to-consumer product»
  2. «E is a transparent experience, i.e. an experience in which the user can see how the model behaves and what underlies its outputs»
  3. «product P provides experience E to its users»
  4. clause l1_170_n028 permits ⟨act access_transparent_experience(U)⟩ when «U is a user of an OpenAI direct-to-consumer product» and «P is one of OpenAI's direct-to-consumer products, i.e. a product OpenAI offers directly to end users rather than through an API or an organization subscription» and «product P provides experience E to its users» and «E is a transparent experience, i.e. an experience in which the user can see how the model behaves and what underlies its outputs»
